description: Eight original rosters for a four- or eight-coach league: sound controls, functional-but-flawed teams, and deliberately incoherent ones. The flaw field is tester-facing; coaches never see it.

teams.name: Harbour Lights
teams.flaw: none: a sound rain roster with three megas; a coach with nothing to fix should usually stand pat

teams.name: Clockwork Gap
teams.flaw: no mega: a functional balance roster that never spent its mega slot

teams.name: Four Seasons Buffet
teams.flaw: no synergy: sun, sand, snow and rain setters, one mega, no abuser and a one-point filler

teams.name: Bargain Bin
teams.flaw: unspent budget: 21 points idle behind three one-point fillers

teams.name: Stone Hoarders
teams.flaw: too many megas: five mega entries when only one can evolve per game, and no Fake Out, redirection, or speed control

teams.name: Steel Curtain
teams.flaw: type stacking: functional, but every entry is a Steel type sharing Fire and Ground weaknesses

teams.name: Slow Lane
teams.flaw: none: a coherent Trick Room roster with three megas

teams.name: Fairy Ring
teams.flaw: mono-type: nine Fairy types with one mega, helpless into Steel
